exact_reproduction: NicheCards structure with canonical markers and aliases
Constrained LLM review strictly for low-confidence cases (margin < tau)
approximations: Spatial neighborhood context summarized from k=6 Visium graph rather than continuous attention weights
Closed-world vocabulary restricted to DLPFC cortical layers 1-6 and White Matter
newly_implemented: Direct wrapper supporting both BANKSY and CellCharter spatial cluster inputs
Automated JSON schema validation via Google GenAI SDK

reviews.short_justification: Although the marker profile includes smooth muscle and vascular markers like ACTA2, MYH11, and MYL9 indicating vascular association, the low-confidence prototype assignment defaults to Layer 1 within the constrained cortical layers vocabulary.
The marker genes include SLC17A7 and NR4A2, which are characteristic of deep cortical layers, supporting the prototype assignment of Layer 5 despite the low similarity margin.
The presence of canonical layer 5 marker genes such as PCP4, NEFH, and NEFM strongly supports the assignment of Layer 5.
The presence of canonical upper-layer markers such as CUX2, HOPX, and CALB1 strongly supports assignment to Layer 2, confirming the prototype match despite a low similarity margin.
